items.summary: Recommendation: blocked for public launch and monetization expansion. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; do not send rights outreach or change the gate pending human counsel and owner authorization. Evidence: Woot terms do not confirm commercial/public redistribution, storage, derivatives, prices, images, alerts, or affiliate use; all four data-use items remain unresolved; accuracy, security, and measurement gates are blocked. Fleet compliance is technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown, with 16 sites each missing banner/accept/reject/GA4 evidence and 2 missing privacy/terms evidence. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. No go-live proposal is supported.

Continue read-only evidence capture for SearchWoot. Next evidence action: produce one dated bundle covering repository/deployed data flow, retention/deletion/correction/access behavior, logs and vendors, GA4 settings, consent withdrawal, and stale-data handling. Do not enable tracking, change configuration, deploy, or expand notifications.

No launch-readiness task is closed this cycle. Four SearchWoot legal tasks remain open because direct evidence is absent. Next action is to attach the consolidated read-only evidence bundle, then route rights, jurisdictional privacy, vendor/DPA, and notification-consent gaps to human counsel before any owner launch decision.
